name: Honjou Moe
source:
She is a nurse at Jomiya General Hospital. She is a bespectacled nurse who is always screwing up. 

She is often scolded by the head nurse. She has a slightly M temperament.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1327]Getchu[/url]]
